summary: Banco Santander Chile filed a Form 6-K reporting outcomes of its Ordinary and Extraordinary Shareholders' Meetings held April 28, 2026. The meetings elected directors (including independents), appointed a Chairman and Vice Chairman, approved a dividend of $3.353346317 per share payable May 6, 2026 to shareholders of record April 29, 2026, and amended bylaws related to gender parity and board structure. This is a routine corporate governance and dividend announcement with no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review.
